name: Return the Statuette
summary: A recovered statuette was meant for Menethil Harbor before tragedy interrupted its delivery. You are asked to bring it to Captain Stoutfist at Menethil Keep.

sections.title: An Unfinished Delivery
sections.body: The statuette was meant to reach Menethil Harbor, with Captain Stoutfist at Menethil Keep expected to sign for it. You are asked to finish the delivery.

faq.q: Who is meant to receive the statuette?
faq.answer: Captain Stoutfist at Menethil Keep is expected to sign for the Menethil Statuette.

faq.q: Where was the statuette supposed to go?
faq.answer: The statuette was meant to be delivered to Menethil Harbor.
The Blind Princess was supposed to deliver the statuette before tragedy struck.

faq.q: What is being asked of me?
faq.answer: You are asked to bring the Menethil Statuette to Captain Stoutfist at Menethil Keep.

attribution: In-game quest text: Return the Statuette
